about: Published Maros-Meszaros reference objectives shown to be off by an exact computation. reference.json keeps the published values and every benchmark is still judged against them (matches_reference is unchanged); this file only records what the exact optimum is, how it was computed, and why the published value cannot be met. #980.

huestis.reason: Diagonal Q, two equality rows, x >= 0: the optimum solved in exact rational arithmetic from the file's decimal strings, every KKT condition checked exactly; the published value is 6.49e-6 above it, more than eight printed digits can explain.

hues-mod.reason: huestis with Q scaled by 1e-4, solved the same way; the published value is 6.49e-6 above the exact optimum, the same error scaled with the model.
